title: S8: the Python gate run (both measurements, pyright baseline on click, packed-bundle footprint, README stated limits, ADR 0007 and 0008 follow-through)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 S8: the gate run of the native Python indexer on click 7.1.2 (held-out) and requests 3c7baaa under the committed scorer, through the shipped index path; pyright baseline on click with the committed ground truth; the packed-bundle footprint with the wasm resolvable from the installed tarball; README stated limits; ADR 0007 (third external) and ADR 0008 follow-through. The (a11) held-out integrity terms stand: the report states the informational click run at 3699733 (independent recall 67/80 = 0.8375, requests 57/65 = 0.8769, FAIL on both, NOT the gate run) preceded the (a11) ruling and the incidental grep over test/ that matched two python-gate lines (gate_score.py and its README, scoring-convention text about (a5) Q6, not ground truth; nothing opened or used); a gate FAIL is reported, never tuned against. The 0.1.0 tag and publish stay HELD.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a committed runner invokes the built dist/glyph.js over a clean checkout of click 7.1.2 and requests 3c7baaa from an empty cache, reads the resulting GlyphIndex, and feeds gate_score.py; it fails closed (non-zero, no score) on zero sites, fewer files than the scored package holds, a missing or empty index, or a failed build, proven both ways with a positive control (DEC-303 (a17) 1-2)

the gate runs once from the reviewed head, with glyph commit, sha256 of dist/glyph.js, repository commits, files and sites read, scorer output and input hashes recorded on the task and no ground-truth, scorer or pinned-hash change
the report states the (a11) informational-run and blind-rule disclosure sentences and the click verdict after (a11); a fresh blind sample is requested if click passes by 2 or fewer true sites
the packed tarball installed into an empty directory answers a Python command under node and the bundle footprint is recorded
README stated limits and ADR 0007 and 0008 follow-through are written and lore check is green
bun run check and lore check are green

implementationNotes: HANDOFF 8 (2026-11-25, glyph-cli worker, for the leader's renewal BEFORE the single gate run; read it after HANDOFF 7 on GCLI-77). STATE: S7 (GCLI-82) landed as #130, squash fe934a7, record #131. S8 runner (GCLI-83 part 1) landed as #132, squash f8a080e, runner file test/gate-runner/run_gate.ts reviewed and approved at head 8db8ee5; the file must stay byte-identical (show git diff 8db8ee5 <head> -- test/gate-runner/run_gate.ts empty in the report). (a18) S8a (GCLI-85) is open as opum-ai/glyph-cli#133, branch feat/GCLI-85-nested-project-roots, head c4a3776de6f44e590be78ba18e1159d5a18aa181, rules commit af4d895 first, bun run check 713 pass, lore 0.14.1 clean; the GCLI-85 record (evidence, findings 1-6) lives on that branch and lands with it. The leader re-checks by ref and lands it head-pinned. GCLI-84 (pyright on click) is a held follow-up, informational, not 0.1.0, not before the gate result is committed. GCLI-46 stays open and the 0.1.0 tag and publish stay HELD for the operator. origin/main is 63577d4 untouched; do not promote dev (DEC-93). THE FAILED FIRST ATTEMPT (the S8 report must state it and why): on 2026-11-25 the runner was run once from a clean tree at 8db8ee5 with --fetch on an empty scratch directory (note: --fetch clones AND runs). It FAILED CLOSED at condition 3b, printing NO score and never invoking the scorer: glyph exited 7 on click: 'python: 2 first-party package roots did not resolve to a source root; first: pass_environment at examples/complex/complex/commands/cmd_init.py:1 names complex'. Cause: click ships examples/complex, a standalone project with its own setup.py holding package complex imported from inside it; no default root resolves it so S3 raised its (a7) indeterminate. opum-doc ruled DEC-303 (a18) (ODOC-640): nested project roots are discovered by their marker (pyproject.toml, setup.py or setup.cfg below the repository root); not arm A (name exclusion), B (flag) or C (weaken exit 7). requests has no analogous shape by its file tree (read-only check); the gate would show it. Because the failed run printed no score there is no earlier score to disclose; it is not a gate run. THE GATE RUN (the leader's sequencing): after #133 lands, the leader renews me; the gate then runs ONCE from dev at the landed head, runner byte-identical to 8db8ee5, on EMPTY --fetch directories under scratch (the earlier gate-fetch directory is NOT empty: use a new one, e.g. scratchpad/s8/gate-fetch-2, check it is empty first), from a clean tree, all four contexts green on the landed head. Command: bun test/gate-runner/run_gate.ts --fetch <empty dir>; it builds dist/glyph.js itself. If it fails closed again on a named condition: report the condition, DO NOT patch in place, the leader decides; a different shape on click or requests comes back as a NEW question. If the scorer prints a score THAT is the run: a FAIL is reported and never tuned against. REPORT CONTENT (to the leader, then the gate-result PR): the full record the runner prints (glyph commit and tree state, sha256 of dist/glyph.js, each repository's commit, files and sites read), the scorer output verbatim for click and requests, the statement that the failed first attempt happened and why, the (a11) statement (an informational click run at 3699733 preceded the (a11) ruling: independent recall 67/80 = 0.8375 and requests 57/65 = 0.8769, scorer verdict FAIL on both, NOT the gate run), opum-doc's blind-rule sentence (a grep for 'arm A' over test/ hit two lines in gate_score.py and its README, scoring-convention text about (a5) Q6, not ground truth; nothing was opened or used), and if click passes by 2 or fewer true sites STOP and say so (a fresh blind sample is required). The Python indexer's 0.1.0 criterion is the gate on both repositories separately (recall >= 0.9 with Wilson lower >= 0.8 and precision >= 0.95 on the independent side). THEN the rest of S8 (GCLI-83 ACs 4-6): the packed tarball installed into an empty directory answering a Python command under node (check-package.mjs already runs --language python callers pygreet from the installed tarball) with the footprint recorded, README stated limits, ADR 0007 follow-through (a third external, @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm, beside typescript and commander: the title and Decision still say two), ADR 0008 follow-through; each a separate tracker-or-docs PR as scope allows. DEFERRED (accepted): GCLI-78, 79, 80 follow-ups; S7 N2 (Python code-map index never cached), N5 (latent TDZ import cycle snapshot.ts, language.ts, python/indexer.ts), N7 (test gaps), N8 (eager tree-sitter import); N4-N7 limitations in the README. PROCESS FACTS (additions to HANDOFF 5-7): accountable-human jdnewhouse, actor glyph-cli delegated-agent on every Quest write; --check-ac is 1-BASED. The ownership guard refuses shell-built targets ( paths), a git write in a sibling worktree, and a cd-then-git compound: use literal paths and separate Bash calls. A hook refuses git push joined to any other command (push alone). The pinned lore is invoked as 'npm exec --yes @opum-ai/lore@0.14.1 -- check --strict' and '... -- sync' (NOT '-- lore check'); lore sync must not lose or duplicate a dated log entry (it added the missing fe934a7 entry once). Local bun is 1.3.14 while CI pins 1.4.2: record both. dispatch-floor: node /Volumes/external/repos/opum-agent/tooling/fleet-sweep/bin/dispatch-floor.mjs glyph-cli GCLI-77 --worker glyph-cli --role writer --paths <paths> (GCLI-77 as the at-dev anchor); the leader also re-runs it with --pr. Landing is head-pinned and bare: gh pr merge N --repo opum-ai/glyph-cli --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <full sha>, then switch to dev, git merge --ff-only origin/dev, git branch -D the feature branch; the merge does not switch the checkout. CI watcher: loop until the rollup for the exact head has 4 COMPLETED contexts (Check, Docs, Package, Tracker integrity), tolerating transient gh GraphQL errors (an empty value must not end the loop). Specialists: opum-workflow:implementer, claude-sonnet-5-5 with model_override_reason, run_in_background, cwd the main checkout; briefs state the BLIND RULE (nothing under test/python-gate or test/python-lsp-measurement, no gate, no scorer) and the zsh rules; a finished specialist can be resumed by SendMessage for a follow-on round. Worktrees to keep: review-* (incl. review-82, DEC-208 until LCLI-740 ships), s2a, s3-GCLI-75, s4-GCLI-76, s6-GCLI-72; scratch fetches live under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Volumes-external-repos-glyph-cli/1d89779d-5e96-492c-a173-1cbf111fc4c5/scratchpad/s8/ (click-co, req-co, gate-fetch with click and requests at the pinned commits, smoke fixtures).
